CustomField.formula: TRIM( BLANKVALUE(breg_Address__Street__s, "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__Street__s)), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__City__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__PostalCode__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__CountryCode__s))) ) ), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(breg_Address__City__s, "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__City__s)), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__PostalCode__s)) ) ), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(TEXT(breg_Address__StateCode__s), "") & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__PostalCode__s)) ), " ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(breg_Address__PostalCode__s, "") & IF( AND( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__Street__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__City__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(breg_Address__PostalCode__s)) ), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(breg_Address__CountryCode__s))) ), ", ", "" ) & BLANKVALUE(TEXT(breg_Address__CountryCode__s), "") )
CustomField.label: Affiliation Address
